g.text: Across families — observation, testimony, completion and effects
Zero semantic testimony merely from observation
Authority-stack product law is not a claim that all public routes already conform.
Prompt/response attestations and synthetic HTTP witness events must be
classified against the governing law; method names do not settle that conflict.
ISA execution, cognition completion, evidence admission and effect activation
are different events. Their receipts must not be substituted for one another.
Source-reviewed orchestration. Nested semantics remain open; no runtime acceptance
claimed. Cross-family comparison of explicit law and previously reviewed paths, not a
merged execution pipeline. Modular details link to their own source-backed traces. No
family is promoted to the definition of the invention, and no code observation overrides
